So the white "corner brackets" moved: the top bracket moved from above the right side of the pink bar (columns 43-47) to above the left side (columns 15-19), and the bottom bracket moved from below the left (columns 15-19) to below the right (columns 43-47).

So these white marks moved diagonally? Top mark: columns 43-47 → columns 15-19 (moved left). Bottom mark: columns 15-19 → columns 43-47 (moved right). So LEFT moved the top mark left and the bottom mark right? That's weird. Or maybe these marks are "scroll indicators" for the bar contents: the bar has 5 glyphs, and pressing LEFT shifts the view? Hmm, I see, so the marks are at the ends of the pink bar. Maybe they indicate the "selected glyph" in the pink bar: top mark = the glyph selected in the blue bar? No...
Let me think about the game from a different angle. Maybe it's like this: the blue bar and pink bar each display a sequence of 5 glyphs. The 3x4 grid of tiles displays 12 glyphs. The goal: match the tiles to the bar? The white marks might be a "cursor" that moves along the bar with LEFT/RIGHT, and UP/DOWN selects the bar or the tile grid.
But the top mark moved from the right end to the left end with a single LEFT press — that's a jump of 4 positions, not 1. Unless the marks wrap around a circular sequence of 5 positions: from position 4 (columns 43-47) LEFT → position 3 (columns 36-40)? No, it went to position 0 (columns 15-19).

Or maybe the marks represent the ends of a "selection range": the range went from [0..4] to... no, both are at the ends.
Let me try pressing LEFT again and see what happens. If the marks swap again (back to original), then LEFT toggles. If they move one step, then it's a cursor.
Actually, wait a moment. Maybe these white marks are a "progress" or "score" indicator, or a "remaining moves" bar? They're small (5px wide). Two of them, one above and one below the pink bar. Hmm.
